messages:
alex: Heads-up: PR #8743 needs a second approver before today's cutoff (21:00 UTC). It's blocking rc-2026. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8743 — touches kv-cache warmup + rollout flags. @nina can you take a quick look? CI is green but timing-sensitive.

nina: On it, looking now. will ping with comments in ~15m :eyes:

sam: Quick sanity check — do we need a migration run? I saw a config tweak in rollout service.

alex: No DB migration. Only feature flag gating + an init ordering fix. Unit/integration tests added in the PR. Main concern is perf regression on 2048-token flows.

liz: I'm OOO until 22:30 UTC, can't review before cutoff. If nina can't get in, we should fallback to canary-only deploy.

nina: Found one minor nit in handler ordering, will push a small fix + re-run CI. ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release cutoff at 21:00 UTC in 30 minutes. Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm approvals.

alex: If nina's fix lands and CI passes, I can merge and tag. Otherwise we'll delay to next window. @sam can you smoke perf on staging if merged?

sam: Yes — I'll run the perf check and report within 12m.

nina: Pushed fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/commit/abc123 (small reorder). CI queued.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #8743. All checks green.

sam: Perf looks fine on 2048 runs — ~5% p99 delta, within acceptable bounds.

alex: Great. @liz will you give final thumbs up when available? If not, nina will be second and we can go.

liz: Caught the thread — :thumbsup: quick scan looks OK.

alex: :white_check_mark: merging now. tagging rc-2026-hotfix-1
